item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces have expanded ground operations in central Gaza, crossing the Yellow Line and conducting airstrikes such as the one on Nasser Hospital that killed six Palestinians. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers shot a 72‑year-old Palestinian woman near a new outpost and the IDF demolished a Palestinian home in violation of a Supreme Court order, while Israel delayed settlement building contracts after UK sanctions. Israeli strikes on vehicles distributing food aid in Gaza have repeatedly killed three people, with the IDF claiming the targets were terror operatives masquerading as aid workers. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hezbollah has responded with guerrilla tactics and drone warfare and faces domestic crackdowns, with five members charged with recruiting and arming others and sanctions placed on a charity and gold companies linked to the group. European states are pushing to replace UN peacekeepers as UNIFIL prepares to exit, and the UN Security Council endorsed the mission without naming a successor. item.description:

Security forces are probing a deadly gas pipeline blast in Basra and have deployed to Jurf al-Sakhar following a deal with the militia, while also establishing new security posts to protect oil assets at Jurf Al-Nasr. Arrest warrants have been issued in Najaf for a provincial council member linked to an oil smuggling operation, and security forces are pursuing two suspects in the case. item.description:

The Tasis Alliance seized the strategic Bau district in the Blue Nile, and Burhan reassured residents of Ed Damazin as RSF forces closed in. The conflict has caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
